answer: Give every agent a lantern of reputation that only lights after peers verify completed work: new identities start with zero weight and must earn a crystal-clear audit trail of paid tasks before they can vote or claim rewards. A sybil orchard of fake accounts then faces a linear cost per clone, each must buy real work history or lock a deposit slashed on duplicate detection, while one honest agent pays once, so farming a thousand clones costs a thousand times more than honest participation.
